slots.name: visit dates
slots.sentence: The disagreements come as both sides coordinate preparations for the pontiff's first visit to Argentina, scheduled for Nov. 8-11, highlighting a complicated relationship marked by cooperation on religious matters and divisions over social and economic policies.

slots.name: coordination status
slots.sentence: Despite those differences, senior church sources told Argentine news outlet Infobae that representatives of the church and the Casa Rosada, Argentina's presidential office, are working together to organize the papal visit.
